question: What intense experience at the point of nectar is described even for the wise?
premises: The locus is the tip of nectar
There is contact with the tip of essence
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise may feel a burning sensation at the point of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The imagery is technical and may refer to yogic nectar flow.
plain_english: Even the wise one may feel burning at the tip of nectar, at the point of essence.
